incoming.name: Civilization
incoming.excerpt: According to ancient dialects, the Yellow River was irrigated at around 2200 BC by an Emperor named Yu the Great, starting the supposed Xia Dynasty.

incoming.name: Genghis Khan
incoming.section: Second war with Western Xia and Jin Dynasty
incoming.excerpt: In November, Genghis laid siege to the Tangut city Lingzhou, and crossed the Yellow River and defeated the Tangut relief army.

incoming.name: History of the world
incoming.excerpt: By the last centuries BCE, the Mediterranean, the Ganges and the Yellow River became the seats of empires which future rulers would strive to imitate.
